summary.text: Jon Albert represents District 48 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Albert was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Albert was a member of the Frostproof City Council from 2016 to 2024 and Mayor of Frostproof from 2020 to 2024, and is a business owner who lives in Frostproof.
Albert served in the U.S. Marine Corps for nine years and ten months, and holds a bachelor's degree and an MBA from Chaminade University of Honolulu.
